title: Contractors Plant & Machinery Insurance Policy: Witness Clause and Exceptions
key_items: NOW THIS POLICY OF INSURANCE WITNESSETH
summary: This page from the Contractors Plant & Machinery Insurance policy outlines the preamble, including the insured's proposal, premium payment, and renewal terms. It contains the witness clause, detailing the Company's option to indemnify by payment, reinstatement, or repair for unforeseen and sudden physical damage to insured property, with coverage applying whether items are at work, at rest, during dismantling, cleaning, overhauling, shifting, or re-erection, but only after successful commissioning. Liability is limited to the sum insured per item per period, with reinstatement possible after a claim. The exceptions section lists exclusions: excess borne by insured; electrical or mechanical breakdown (with consequential damage indemnifiable); loss of replaceable parts; explosion of boilers, pressure vessels, or internal combustion engines; vehicles for general road use unless exclusively on construction site; and hull and machinery of waterborne vessels, except for contractors plant mounted on waterborne vessels for contract work. The page also includes registered office and contact details.

title: THE COMPANY SHALL NOT BE LIABLE UNDER THIS POLICY IN RESPECT OF
summary: This document outlines the Contractors Plant & Machinery Insurance policy from TATA AIG, covering unforeseen physical damage to insured property with indemnity via payment, reinstatement, or repair. It details coverage during various operations, sum insured limits, and reinstatement options. Exceptions exclude excess, breakdowns, replaceable parts, explosions, road vehicles, waterborne vessels, tidal immersion, transit, wear and tear, misuse, underground machinery, war, nuclear risks, pre-existing faults, willful acts, supplier responsibility, consequential loss, and inventory-discovered damage, with burden of proof on the insured for certain exclusions. Provisions require sum insured to equal replacement cost including freight, duties, customs, and erection costs.

title: PROVISIONS
summary: This document outlines the exclusions, provisions, conditions, and miscellaneous terms of a Contractors Plant & Machinery Insurance policy. It details what is not covered (e.g., tidal immersion, transit, wear and tear, testing, underground works except tunneling, war, nuclear risks, pre-existing faults, willful acts, supplier responsibility, consequential loss, inventory discoveries) and places the onus of proof for certain exclusions on the insured. It specifies the Sum Insured requirement (replacement cost), Basis of Indemnity for repairs or total destruction (including costs, depreciation, salvage, and proportional payment for underinsurance), and conditions for payment. It covers policy conditions (fraud, admission, defense, conditions precedent), miscellaneous duties (recovery, evidence), obligations of the insured (maintenance, inspections, notification of changes), duties following an accident (notice, minimization, preservation, claim form within 14 days, minor repairs, inspection, cessation of liability), other insurances (rateable proportion), position after claim (no abandonment, sum insured reduction, reinstatement), transfer of interest, termination (by either party with premium adjustments), recourse (subrogation assistance), arbitration clause, renewal notice, and grievance redressal contact information.

title: Insurance Policy Clauses: Reinstatement, Transfer, Termination, Arbitration, Renewal, Grievance
summary: The page covers insurance policy clauses on reinstatement of sum insured after compensation, transfer of interest requiring company consent, termination options with premium adjustments, insured's recourse duties for subrogation, arbitration agreement under the 1996 Act, renewal with possible changes, grievance redressal procedures with contact details, and includes registered office, customer support, and regulatory information.
